name: @neuropause/certification
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Validation & Production Certification harness (NCEA 16.0). VALIDATION TOOLING ONLY — it introduces no runtime or platform feature and no new subsystem. It composes the existing eleven packages to record actual cross-package evidence: an end-to-end integration proof, upgrade/migration/rollback validation against real Postgres, a real in-process benchmark harness (startup, memory, audit/crypto/DB/recovery latency), and a four-tier evidence matrix (VERIFIED / ARCHITECTURE-READY / INFRA-PENDING / PILOT-VERIFIED). Anything needing customer infrastructure, cloud services, production traffic, or external audit is INFRA-PENDING or PILOT-VERIFIED — never fabricated as VERIFIED.
